d: Malaysia has been a favourite destination for Indian tourists, thanks to its visa-free entry facility introduced in late 2023. But that convenience is coming to an end. From January 1, 2027, Indian passport holders will need a visa before travelling to the country. In this video, Firstpost examines why Malaysia is scrapping the exemption despite recording strong Indian tourist arrivals. The move comes after warnings about Indians being misled by agents with false job offers and misusing the facility to seek employment.
